trace.application: synthetic per-request variable-length speculative verification snapshots
trace.provenance: request order and pre-query context lengths from original synthetic Q4 trace; Q sampled independently
trace.limitation: not an observed service/draft trace; independent snapshots, no acceptance/throughput claim

contract.query: compact active prefix of fixed TND storage; zero-query inactive requests
contract.q_descriptor: int64 cumulative endpoints, WITHOUT leading zero
contract.kv_descriptor: int64 local length per request, including current query
contract.output: all physical rows finite, inactive tail exactly zero
contract.pages: fixed request-owned disjoint pages, source request IDs preserve cache ownership
contract.capacity: 512 from original default capture catalog; one fixed graph, no new capture size

predeclared_gate.candidate: only a new repeated cost remaining after community shared device metadata
predeclared_gate.rule: both required; attributable removable cost, not total compute or an already shared producer
predeclared_gate.no_budget: close screening without candidate implementation or kernel tuning enumeration
